name: reg-exp-value-test-30e03bfeee/regexp-value-v.bal
spec_references: ## Expressions: "Currently support `nil-literal`, `boolean-literal`, `numeric-literal` and `string-literal` only"; the positive expression list includes XML and string template expressions but no regular-expression template expression.

# Subset restrictions / ## Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; `ballerina/lang.string` lists `Char` and string operations but not `RegExp`; `ballerina/lang.error` lists only `message`.

## Invocations / ### Other invocation restrictions: "Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:" includes `error:message` and `value:toString`, but not `error:detail`.
reason: The case fundamentally requires regular-expression templates and string:RegExp, neither covered by the subset's positive lists. It asserts preservation of regex syntax through toString, interpolation and invalid-insertion parsing errors, regex equality and exact equality, and regex values in runtime annotations. These essential regex behaviors are outside the supported subset. Invalid-insertion assertions additionally call the unsupported error.detail langlib method.
unsupported_constructs: Regular-expression template expressions (re backtick syntax), including interpolation, character classes, flags and groups
string:RegExp type and its asserted serialization, equality, parsing-error and annotation-value behavior
test_design_notes: io:println calls only instrument completed test functions and do not determine classification.
Supported value:toString, equality operators, trap and annotation syntax do not establish support for regex-specific behavior.
